images.name: 窗台工作台
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing.
Create one finished high fidelity professional GAME UI DESIGN BOARD for Little Elsewhere, proposal "40  窗台工作台 / Windowsill Atelier". Landscape 4:3 presentation with a small title above a large 16:9 main game view occupying the upper approximately 70%, and an OFF-SCREEN design detail strip below containing three enlarged interaction states connected by subtle arrows.

Image 1 is the LOCKED GAME BACKGROUND IMAGE, not inspiration. INSERT THE PROVIDED BACKGROUND IMAGE UNMODIFIED AS THE MAIN GAME VIEW. Do not redraw it, do not reinterpret its style, do not alter its colors, time of day, composition, tree, birds, houses, river, snow mountains, railing or existing objects. Only add interface graphics over it. Existing forest tree left, river center, building right, two pots, coffee cup and closed green book on the sill remain exactly as supplied.

Interface direction: Japanese cozy illustrated journal, refined restrained cream paper and slate pencil lines, muted olive accents, tiny hand-drawn original icons, pixel-like badge details. Rich and thoughtful interactions without large decorative frames. Main view UI covers about 8–12% of its image, mostly edges. Calm hierarchy and readable controls, not just three plain text buttons. This design uses the existing windowsill objects as interaction entrances: a delicate small hotspot/underline and "图鉴" tab attached to the EXISTING green book; a small feeding status tag near EXISTING food dish with seed icon, "余粮 68%" and a refill action; a compact focus/audio control near EXISTING coffee cup showing "25:00", play/pause and a small sound icon. Never draw new physical props into the landscape. At upper-left a small two-line visiting note with sparrow avatar "麻雀来访" and five familiarity dots. Upper-right tiny weather and log icons, a single discreet "新记录 2" badge. No large heading inside the actual game. Central water and mountains remain completely visible.

Below the main game image, on a light off-white design-board background that is EXPLICITLY NOT part of the game viewport, show three well-sized polished detailed UI states:
1. "翻开图鉴": a compact illustrated field-guide drawer with three category tabs 鸟类 / 昆虫 / 奇遇, 6 species thumbnails including two undiscovered silhouettes, small collection progress 12/50, selected sparrow with favorite star.
2. "补充鸟食": a modest popover with three illustrated seed choices and quantity chips, subtle feeding progress, clear "补充" button and "取消" text button.
3. "开始陪伴": a compact focus card with 25 / 45 / 自定义 duration choices, ambient volume sliders with bird/water/rain icons, one "开始" button and a small discover-later notification queue.
Make these three INTERACTION STATES very clear and useful with actual controls and information hierarchy. Not a row of ornamental stickers. They must be readable enough to evaluate the design.

Short Chinese words above must be legible and correct. Avoid long fake paragraphs. Board title exactly "40  窗台工作台" and smaller "Little Elsewhere / Windowsill Atelier". Use restrained fine lines and plenty of breathing room, consistent icon grammar. No game engine chrome, no debug toolbar, no giant UI panels over the scenery, no glowing sci-fi dashboard, no oily paint, no heavy woodcarving, no vines or fantasy frames. The original background must stay visually unchanged. This is a DESIGN IMAGE, not implementation or a generic web dashboard.
